property_summary: For every call, the deployed reference contract C.version() returns the exact semantic version string "1.0.0"; the mutant returns a different string (e.g. "1.0.0-alpha") for some inputs, breaking the equality property.
change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to include a prerelease tag "1.0.0-alpha".
mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.0-alpha"; }
